And then his eyes started to shake, and the fingers upon my cheeks trembled slightly. He opened his mouth, but all I could hear was the quiet sound of an airy gasp, as if he was just surfacing after nearly getting drowned.
Definitely not a response I expected to get from asking a question back.
"W-why?" I reached out to grasp his cold cheeks. "What happened? Did I say something wrong--"
"No," he cut me swiftly, with the same voice he used when he said that he loved me. "You said something very, very, very ’right’."
Obviously, I got even more confused, until I heard what he said next with glazed eyes. "You heard it," he whispered, pressing his lips hard on my forehead, before pulling away and repeating. "You can finally hear it..."
What...what did he mean by I can finally hear--
Oh? Oh!
"T-the Egg?" now, even my own voice was trembling. "Y-you mean...that’s the name of the Egg?"
"Oh, sweetheart," he pulled me into a kiss; just a short one, and he proceeded to lift me like a child until I yelped in surprise. I grabbed his shoulder tight for balance, blinking at the sudden height I was subjected to, looking over the top of his head. He peppered kisses on my cheek and jaw, and started to laugh in the middle of it. "Oh, God--you finally able to hear it!"
It was a pure, unadulterated joy reflected on his pair of sparkling moons that shimmered softly under the sunlight. His face was lit up by the slight color up on his cheeks and the curl of his lips.
I spent a long time being stunned at the way this demon could appear even more beautiful than he already was, and didn’t even realize he had started walking toward the house.
"Hey," my eyes narrowed as a certain memory resurfaced. "You’re lying when you said you were kidding, right?"
"Hmm? What are you talking about?" he tilted his head cheerfully.
"You said you were kidding about the person being able to hear the egg’s name to be your one true love," I pursed my lips at the memory of the first time I was truly annoyed by him. "You actually meant it, didn’t you?"
His eyes widened slightly, before he broke out a soft laugh. "Oh, that--perhaps I really was," he smiled amusedly when my lips twisted even more. "After all, I thought my ’destiny’ should be you, Valen, and no one else."
Ah...from his perspective, who was allegedly even gotten sent to another world temporarily to meet me, he must have thought that his ’one true love’ could only be me. I, on the other hand, was still struggling with the thought that even if it was, it might be Valmeier rather than me. And that was why I got hurt and angry at that time.
But then again, even if I knew he considered me as his one true love, not being able to hear the name of the Egg--I mean, Seed--would probably make me even sadder.
But now, he must have felt as if the stars were finally aligned.
"But even if the so-called ’destiny’ isn’t you, it wouldn’t change the fact that you are my one true love," he smiled widely, as if nothing could dampen his mood today. "As it had always been, and as it always will be."
Oh, fine! How could I stay annoyed at this flirty demon?
"But...what exactly is the Primordial Seed?"
He paused for a bit, making a pondering face. "Hmm...I think it’ll be best if I explain further once we get back, with the Seed in front of us," he said. "Not that I had much explanation."
Hmm...curiouser and curiouser.
But well, I guessed for now, it was good enough that the censorship had been lifted for me. I wondered when it happened, though, since we had never talked about the Egg again. But if I had to take a guess...
"Oh! Could it be because my soul is whole now?" I gasped at this realization, and Natha nodded in agreement.
"I thought so too,"
Wow...things really got solved one by one once my soul was fixed. Fascinating.
[Master! Jade know how many nights now!] Suddenly, we could hear the little bird chirping loudly as we arrived in front of the side door leading to the drawing room. The colorful rocket swooshed down cheerfully right at me. [It’s--why Nightmare carry Master? Master sick?!]
"No!" I swiftly denied it so Jade would stop panicking. The flaps of the wings grew calmer and Jade landed on my shoulder with a confused look on its little face. So I looked back at Natha with pressed lips. "Why are you carrying me? Let me go now."
I mean, I had asked him earlier, but he just decided to ignore me. And now, he just replied nonchalantly. "Why not?"
"Because I have perfectly working legs?"
"I also have perfectly sturdy arms," he said with a playful smirk, even proceeding to pat my thigh as if proving his claim.
I hit his shoulder to protest, even pursing my lips in annoyance, but he just laughed and looked so...joyful and innocent that I ended up just letting him carry me like a child into the room. It got even more embarrassing because now, there were servants to spectate.
Oh, well...I should probably try to get used to it from now on, because clearly, we were not living in a modern home with just the two of us and some pets; there would always be other people in our living space, from servants to my little companions.
And Natha had gotten even more publicly affectionate to me as well. Not that he wasn’t before, but at most, he would just hold my hand or caress my hair. All the other stuff he did when it was just the two of us.
But as if something finally snapped in him, now he just raining kisses on me whenever and wherever he liked. He’d been the one helping me put on my clothes, personally choosing which one I would wear that day. Arta told me Natha looked like a man in a honeymoon phase, and...uhh...well, there was probably some kind of truth in it.
In a sense, this week--although three of those days were a mess--was when we finally met. Like...for real. When we made it clear who we were, what we had been feeling. The cloud of doubt and fear was dispersing and Natha probably just felt so relieved that there was no longer a threat of my soul vanishing again.
It was like...we finally became true lovers? There was no secret anymore--at least about our feeling for each other.
He had been holding back on calling my name for almost seven decades, and it showed--because now, he also called me Valen openly, and a lot. It made me realize that he had been either calling me ’Val’ or ’sweetheart’ all this time.
I didn’t know if it was because he didn’t want to call me by someone else’s name when he knew what mine was, or because ’Val’ was the name I gave him when he asked me after he--ahem--kidnapped me to the Lair. It probably felt like he was cheating somewhat if he called me by Valmeier’s name.
And now, he just called my name whenever. Valen, have this; Valen, let’s go; Valen, come here--
Almost made me wish he called me sweetheart again.
I was happy to be able to hear my name again, but hearing it coming out of my mouth as if it was dripped in honey, coated with sugar, and sprinkled with marshmallows was...
Let’s just say I turned into a boiled crab easily.
Ah, right--I almost forgot. "So how many nights it is?" I asked the little bird as we stepped into the drawing room. Panne had prepared my second breakfast there--just some biscuits and fruit--and Natha finally allowed me to use my own perfectly working legs.
[A lot! More than a hundred!] Jade replied before flying to the plate of jelly on the table. Even though it already had some jelly during breakfast.
"A hundred nights seem right," I chuckled. "Almost as old as you!"
[Huh?] Jade paused from pecking on the jelly and lifted the green head, blinking in surprise.
"That’s why Natha said the spring will come when you’re no longer a child," I explained with a laugh. "Because you’ll be twice older!"
[Huuuuh?!]
The jelly was getting forgotten at this point, because the little bird made an expression as if it was just facing a life-altering, world-bending reality. Beady eyes got even rounder and small beaks parted in wonder.
Hmm...was it that surprising?
And then, the little bird spoke with a gasp. [Nightmare...not make fun of Jade?]
I had to bend over to catch my breath from laughing too much after that.

chapters.title: Chapter 204: Look at me living my Live Love Laugh life
chapters.content:
Chapter 204: Look at me living my Live Love Laugh life
"Ah, there’s something I forgot to ask you!" I clapped my hand as I looked at the river that got further and further away from the airship.
"Hmm? What is it? Is it about the druid?" Natha tilted his head.
Ah, yes, it was too bad that Amarein couldn’t board the airship in the end. She felt it would be impolite for her to impose on the request after offending Natha, so she said she would look for another chance in the future.
But that wasn’t it.
"Hey, do you know where the hidden passage leading to?" I asked Natha. I had forgotten about the passage all this time--I even forgot to mention that I found the passage.
"Hmm..." Natha tapped on his arm as he dug his memories, before pointing to a cliff on the hill beside the river. "It should be somewhere around that, if I recall correctly. There should be boats and provisions in a room protected by a preservation barrier near the exit point."
"So people could run away through the river?"
Natha nodded, looking at me with a smile. "Seems like your adventure was a success?"
A success...should I call it that? Well, despite all the problems and angst that followed, it resulted in us ending all the misunderstanding and me gaining my name--myself--again, so...
"Mm, it’s a success!"
Natha smiled and ruffled my head as I laughed, staring one last time at the port city that now became a very important place for me. A place where I found my place again in this world. A place where I realized Natha truly loved me.
Yeah, he was right--a journey was very helpful to discovering oneself.
From finding out I could do good for people by purifying the environment, meeting Ignis, and finding out the truth about me and Valmeier, even getting our souls merged...
It was so eventful that I could hardly believe we were only halfway through the inspection. That being said, there was nothing much happening during the rest of the journey. We would stop in towns and cities, going around the regions, and talking to the citizens--well, Natha did.
I spent days going around sightseeing the towns with Arta, Panne, and the guards. We’d go to shops selling crafts to look for souvenirs, candy stores for Jade, and snacks for the rest of us--including Ignis who liked spicy things. And then we would visit a nice cafe to have afternoon tea before getting back to our lodging, enjoying snacks we didn’t usually get in L’Anaak Eed.
"Jade, try eating this," I took a skewer of candied fruit, three green-colored berries covered in melted sugar that looked like sparkling gems.
[Weird] Jade tilted its head, but still inching closer, looking at the candid fruit suspiciously. [Look like fruit, but Jade smell candy]
"Right?" I giggled at the way Jade’s green head looked almost similar to the candied green berries. "It’s a fruit inside a candy, fascinating, right?"
"That red one looks better," Ignis remarked, pointing at another skewer even though the Salamander decided it wouldn’t like sweet--because Ignis was an adult, the little gecko said.
Narrowing its green eyes skeptically, Jade pecked on the topmost piece and put it inside its mouth. We could hear a crunchy sound and Jade jumped, eyes widened and blinking in surprise. [Juicy fruit! Sweet candy! Weird!]
Ah, the water inside the fruit exploding after the crunchy sugar must have been a strange experience. I felt the same too when I took a bite before this. As Jade decided to hound the rest of the candied fruit for itself, I wondered if there was a popping candy in this world. If there was, it would finish the candy bucket list I had in my previous life.
Wasn’t it fascinating that I could still check them out one by one even in another world?
Flamed with curiosity, Ignis hopped into the table and approached the candied fruit’s plate. The Salamander was finally able to control its external flame so Ignis was no longer a fire hazard to the environment now. But when it bit into the red candied berries, the sugar immediately melted.
"Ah, Valen! What is this?" the little gecko--the mighty Salamander--flailing as the sticky sweet liquid slathered all over its snout, and I had to stifle my laugh while helping the gecko wipe the sugar off its face. "Ugh--annoying thing!"
"It’s because your internal temperature is still too high," I explained with a laugh.
"Then give me that yummy ball again!" Ignis stomped away in annoyance, probably feeling embarrassed that its dignity failed with this clumsy event.
"Yes, yes--we’ll get one when we passed the other volcano in the south, okay?" I patted the gecko’s no longer flaming head. It was too bad for Ignis, but natural fire elemental mana was hard to come by. Fire from the hearth did not have a sustainable life force after all. Aside from volcanoes, the best option would probably extract it from lightning.
As I mulled over this lack of fire elemental mana, Arta finally opened her mouth after merely watching us in silence.
"Young Master, may I ask something?"
"Mm?"
"Why is His Lordship and Sir Salamander calling you ’Valen’?"
I looked up and blinked, only then realizing that people must have been confused that Natha called me Valen instead of Valmeier. I wondered if they thought I wasn’t the Priest of Judgment they knew me as all this time. But even if they had that thought, they knew I had Alveitya, and the exact same face as Valmeier.
Even so, it wasn’t something that they could just ask, especially in front of Natha. The servants probably chose to not think about it too much, because it got nothing to do with them. But the vassals were probably madly confused and curious, and from the look on Arta’s face, she had been wanting to ask me about it for a long time already. The only reason she held this long--until the last town before we get back home--was probably because Lesta told her not to.
"What are you talking about?" the one who replied first was actually Ignis. "Because that’s his name, of course. What else should I call him with?"
Ignis used to call me ’Master’ or ’New Master’, but after hearing Natha called me Valen a lot, the Salamander started to call me that too. Because for the mighty legendary beast, a name was the most important thing a person should have.
So...yeah, what else should I reply with?
"...because it’s my name," I copied the Salamander.
"Yes?" Arta tilted her head.
I repeated again with a sigh, "Because it’s my name,"
Now, even Panne and the guards looked at me with inquisitive eyes. I bit the inside of my cheek, and after mulling about it for a few seconds, looked at them with a smile.
"Let me introduce myself," I put my hand in front of my chest, looking into their eyes one by one, straightened my back and firmed my voice. "I used to be Valmeier, but now you may call me Valen."
Arta blinked, probably more because of my demeanor rather than my words. "Young Master...Valen?" she said slowly, carefully, accentuating every syllable.
"Yes," I nodded firmly, for the first time hearing my name coming out of her mouth.
And it felt nice.
Arta looked at me silently for a while. "Alright," she nodded, the corner of her eyes softened as she smiled widely and reached out her hand. "Nice to meet you, Young Master Valen,"
"Nice to meet you too!"
I shook her hand above the table, and we ended up laughing out loud for our silliness. It wasn’t like they would use my name when addressing me--they couldn’t, more like, culturally--but now I knew they would use that name when they talked about me or something with other people.
"Hmm...is this why Young Master seems different these days?" she leaned forward and looked at me with more interest than usual.
"Really?" I tilted my head. I did feel different, considering everything that happened. But I didn’t think I projected it much--unlike Natha who was comparably smothering me every time he got back from his inspection routine.
"Mmm...how should I say this?" Arta looked up to ponder while tapping on the table to gather her thoughts. "Ah--Lesta said you seem more confident,"
"Oh?"
"Like...you seem more sure about yourself," she looked into my eyes and smiled. "You don’t mind looking into the other’s eyes now, and you seem to be more at ease."
Huh...was that how I was before? I didn’t realize it until now, but if I thought about it, I probably hid behind Natha too much every time we were in a public setting. I got nervous easily in front of people, and it might have a lot to do with the fact that I had something I vehemently hide; that I wasn’t actually Valmeier, and I wasn’t originally part of this world.
But now that I didn’t have those burdens anymore, it lessened my nervousness--or rather, uncertainty.
The hem of my clothes rarely got crumpled now, and Arta was so happy seeing my pristine clothes.
"Ah...well," I smiled sheepishly. "I do feel more...settled."
"Hmm," Arta leaned forward even more, her dark eyes narrowed and she spoke quietly. "Is this because..."
My own eyes narrowed at this reaction as I responded confusedly. "What?"
"You know..."
Her smile and the look in her eyes started to feel so much like what Rubha and the other courtesans gave me. "...What?"
"Because you and His Lordship had--"
"Lalalalalala! Look Jade--that store looks interesting! See what they sell!" I ordered my companions and sent the little bird away before turning back to Arta and hissing. "Are you crazy? In front of my child?!"
Arta playfully covered her mouth with her fingers. "Oops?"
"And that’s not the case!" I told her with pursed lips. Me feeling settled was definitely not because I finally wasn’t a virgin--maiden?--anymore!
Well...maybe a little bit?
But that definitely wasn’t all! Is it even possible in the first place to gain confidence from having sex?
Or is it?
"Pfft--fine," Arta chuckled again, still smiling amusedly at my response, before adding with a shrug. "What’s there to get embarrassed about when you’re already sleeping in the same bed all the time?"
"Well..." I bit my cheek to quell the seeping embarrassment, more because Panne and the guards were deliberately averting their gaze from our table. "Ugh--anyway, that’s not it!"
"Yes, yes~"
Aaaagh!

chapters.title: Chapter 205: Whatever the age, we act the same when we’re in love
chapters.content:
Chapter 205: Whatever the age, we act the same when we’re in love
Since it was the last day of inspection before going back, we didn’t return to the lodging, but straight to the airship parked on the hill. Natha came in time for dinner, and we spent time sorting out the things I bought today while he asked about my day. We lounged on the bedroom couch as the airship moved again, sampling some local wine that Natha asked Arta to procure before.
"They said I changed," I made my report after mulling over it while holding into a pretty porcelain doll with a beautiful and intricate dress. The doll was of a succubus, so I was thinking of giving one to Zia.
"Who are ’they’?"
"The vassals,"
"Hmm..." Natha, who was braiding my hair, tilted his head and asked over my shoulder. "Changed how? Prettier?"
"Hey, I’m trying to be serious here!" I smacked his leg--which was caging me from behind--and pursed my lips in disapproval.
"Haha," he laughed softly and pecked my cheek as an apology. "So what did they say?"
It was actually kind of embarrassing repeating what Arta told me this afternoon, but I managed to spell it even though it made me blush for a bit. "They said I seem more confident..."
Fortunately, Natha did not laugh. "Do you feel more confident?" he asked while tying the end of my braid with a cord. He brought the braided hair to one side and kissed my now-exposed neck.
"I...think so?" I put the doll away and looked at my torso--my chest. The steady heartbeat that was wholly mine. "I feel...belonged, finally,"
"Good," Natha gently pulled me back until I was leaning against his chest. As I looked up, I could see his silver eyes gazing at me softly, fondly. He strokes my cheek, speaking in a gentle but firm tone. "You belong here. You live here now, right?"
"Yeah," I returned his sweet smile, sighing in contentment and closing my eyes as I sunk deeper into his embrace. With a smirk, I told him another thing the vassals said to me. "They said you’re changing too,"
"Me?" his voice sounded confused. "What about me?"
I opened my eyes and saw his genuinely clueless face, and I felt flabbergasted. This demon would know if I lost even a kilogram of weight but he couldn’t see how different he’d been acting these past few weeks?
Shifting myself so I could turn around and face him better, I threw him a question while narrowing my eyes. "Don’t you realize you’ve been more..."
"Yes?"
I looked down at his hands, which were grabbing my waist nonchalantly, as if he did it unconsciously, and pulled me to straddle his lap. "Uhh...touchy?" I looked up and saw the mischievous glint inside the silver eyes, curling like a pair of crescents. He was definitely enjoying this; playing dumb. "Flirty?"
"I’m someone in love, how else would I act?" he tilted his head and made an innocent face, as if he was a youthful demon I met for the first time instead of a mighty Demon Lord who already lived for almost a century.
But damn--that fake innocence did work.
It brought me back to the cold but warm days inside my hospital room; nights full of silly banters and serious discussions. The tingling sensation of realizing I had a crush on him, the nervousness of waiting for him to visit, even while I had to fight sleepiness. The fluster at his charming smirk, and the awe of his sweet smile. The anticipation and disappointment of a single graze and accidental touches.
A love story I had no courage of dreaming of.
"If..." I put my arms around his neck, shifting closer to accommodate the quiet sound coming out between my lips. "If there was no restriction at that time during your possession, if...if it was you who was getting transmigrated there for real...what--"
"Then I would not hesitate to confess," he told me, as he said, without hesitation. His hands were now steadily on my back, as if giving support to my quivering heart. "I would tell you how I feel, I would ask for the taste of your lips."
"Probably tasted like medicine,"
He smirked at my snark, and leaned forward to kiss my chin lightly. "Who knows--I’ll ask for a taste every day to see if it’s consistent,"
I snorted at his cheesy remark, before carefully, hesitatingly asking again. "Even though...even though I don’t have much time?"
He paused for a bit, and I could feel his hands tightening around me. His eyes were shaking for a second, but I waited for an answer still. Eventually, he smiled and looked at me with a firm gaze--as firm as the voice he replied with. "I’d rather have your limited time than any power or riches in the world, Valen."
I bit my lips and buried my face in his neck, sinking into the comfort of his caress on my hair and his stroke on my back.
"There were times...when I almost couldn’t hold back," he said, rubbing my nape soothingly. "Times when I wanted to ask for your hand, for your kiss...for your heart,"
"Why didn’t you?"
I mumbled the question against his skin, but he could still hear the incoherent sound and chuckled at the slight annoyance in my voice. "Because I’m a coward," he said. "I’m young and weak and cowardly."
I lifted my head to look at his wry smile, blinking in surprise at this confession he made on a vulnerable face.
"I was barely an adult spending five years in seclusion after a traumatic war," Natha smiled. "I’m a messy boy experiencing the wonder of love for the first time, so you have to excuse my clumsiness for a bit."
Ah...
I forgot that when he was possessing the young doctor, Natha was only what--thirty, at most? He was around Zia’s age then--and it put me in perspective of how young he was by demon standard.
Indeed, he was smarter than his peer, and his circumstances made him more mature. But they said men always regress when they were in love; even a mature adult would act like a teenage boy when they fell in love.
So, essentially, Natha just acted like...well, me.
Me then, and me right now; constantly nervous and in confusion about what to do. Feeling both courageous and cowardly at the same time. Thinking so much about every little thing, mulling over even the smallest touch.
The only difference was that...I tend to let it out in my face, wearing my heart on my sleeve.
No wonder he was very competitive and stubbornly looking for a perfect answer to all my questions--this nerd. So even Matsa Ra Natha had those inexperienced days, huh?
My lips curled unconsciously, even as I leaned forward and kissed him. What would it be like, if we both took the courage of confronting our feelings toward each other back then? Would it be sweet? Or would it be bitter with the impending separation; either he was getting sent back, or I died.
Would it comfort me during my last days, or would it feel agonizing? Would it make things easier, or would it make it harder to leave with so much regret?
Would it make me dare to dream again?
Ah, didn’t matter now.
Now that we were here, together again, with no visible time stamp. Now we could explore the feelings that were buried back then, relishing the dreams and visions of the future I had never dared to look forward to.
We stared at each other after that slow and soft kiss; his hands on my waist, my arms around his neck. My heart felt like it was getting tickled by feathers, and my stomach kept tingling and heating up under his gaze.
"So...umm..."
"Hmm?"
"We...we are going straight home, right?" I asked while fiddling with the thin chain around his neck.
"Home," he repeated with a bright smile. "It sounds so nice coming from your lips," and as if accentuating his point, he gave my lips a light peck. "But yes, we’ll be taking the route near the volcano as you requested."
I whispered to correct him. "As Ignis requested,"
He chuckled and replied in agreement. "As you said, Young Master."
"How long does it take?"
"Before we reach the volcano? Two--three days? The sky above the southern mountain range is rather misty, so the Captain will move more carefully," he told me readily, leaning back to the couch and pulling me along to shift closer.
"Mm..."
He rubbed my chin and lifted my lowered face, looking at me inquisitively. "Why?"
I blinked slowly, merely looking at him without saying anything. My brain was fighting between embarrassment and desire, clutching his neck as my heartbeat spiked up.
"Sweetheart?"
Unknowingly, I swallowed hard the nervousness that I had, and my voice came out quietly. "Would you..." my eyes darted everywhere but his face, and in the end just stay lowered, looking at his collarbone.
"Would you like to, umm..." I tried once again, but I felt too shy to let the world know what I was thinking about, so, after biting my lips in contemplation, I leaned forward and whispered in his ears.
I could feel his hands tighten on my waist with every word I whispered into his ears. When I pulled back with burning cheeks and a sheepish gaze, he looked at me in astonishment.
"Seriously?" he raised his brow, seemingly couldn’t believe what I just ’requested’. Well, even I couldn’t believe it; that I could be asking for something like that.
"Well..." I bit my lips again and looked around, shrugging. "I don’t think we can do it any other time, and...airship," I told him my reasoning.
He looked at me wordlessly, amusedly, before his lips stretched into a smile.
"Hah!" the next thing I knew, I was already gasping at a new height as Natha suddenly stood up with me still holding into his neck and straddling his hips. He held me tight and I felt like I could see him snarling before diving into my neck and whispered in a voice laden with arousal. "Who am I to deny such an offer?"

chapters.title: Chapter 206: Make sure to leave your child to a trustworthy babysitter while having your honeymoon
chapters.content:
Chapter 206: Make sure to leave your child to a trustworthy babysitter while having your honeymoon
"They’re not going to come out today too, huh?" Opti looked in the direction of the bedroom gallery after they had their breakfast.
The last time they saw the Lord and his pretty bride was during two dinners ago. A whole day had passed and now, as they flew across the rich southern plateau toward the volcanic mountain range, the couple still hadn’t emerged from their bedroom. The servants and Panne, who went there yesterday morning to deliver their Master’s morning drink, found the door--and the whole bedroom itself--clad in isolation barrier.
Well, no need for a genius to know what was going on inside.
"It’s not a rut, right?" Caba asked worriedly; whether he was worried about the Lord or the human-druid, no one knew.
"There’ll be a whole different kind of barriers if that’s the case," Lesta shook his head, before adding with a smirk. "I don’t think they’ll move at all until we reached the volcano."
"Wild," Opti chuckled. "What would happen during their real honeymoon if it’s like this already?"
That remark put the vassals in a sudden silence as they ponder this matter.
"You know...despite calling Young Master his bride, His Lordship never mentioned any wedding plan," Lesta, who was the one accompanying the Lord the most among the vassals, told them with a slight frown. "It wasn’t like him to never prepared for this thing, even if it only happens in the far future."
"Hmm..." Opti leaned back in his chair until the legs of it lifted off the floor, taking advantage of their Lord’s absence to be a bit playful. "Somehow, they’ve been acting like a newly formed couple these past few weeks, don’t you think?"
It was surprising enough when their Lord suddenly told them about taking the Priest of Judgment as his bride. They had steeled themselves to face harsh backlash, confusing themselves about how to face this human. Some of them had been working behind the scene by the Lord’s order to make everything conducive for the human’s arrival; from security measures to public propaganda.
But nothing--nothing prepared them to see their Lord’s eyes filled with so much love and affection, worry and rage. Their cold, calm, unfazed Lord was now pampering his bride non-stop. If they were together, the Lord’s gaze would never leave the human. If his hands were idle, they would almost always touch the human; holding the fair hand, on the small waist, across the shoulder, through the dark, long hair. He wouldn’t touch his meal until he made sure the human ate. He wouldn’t touch his glass until he made sure the human drank. His attention would always be, first and foremost, toward his lovely bride.
Even when they weren’t together, the vassals would sometimes find the Lord making a brooding face, mumbling the human’s name--the new name; Valen. After many decades of serving the Lord, they finally saw him being impatient to finish his work, just so he could see his awaiting lover as soon as he could.
"It’s like they are starting their relationship all over again," Opti laughed. "Perhaps that’s why? Maybe His Lordship wants Young Master to be completely ready first,"
"Right after that long coma, huh," Lesta tilted his head left and right, tapping on his crossed arms. "He’d been acting like he was afraid Young Master will vanish from thin air."
"His Lordship did look like he would end the world and then himself at that time," Caba commented, and their mind automatically conjured up memories from those two days of hell before the Lord decided to whisk himself over to the realm of nature.
Remembering that moment made them shudder again from an intangible cold.
"Stop chatting! We have another problem for now!" Dhuarta, who had been out of the conversation earlier suddenly yelled from the side. In her hands was a plump, colorful elemental bird wailing loudly.
[Jade want to see Master!]
The little bird, who had been waiting restlessly for a whole day and night yesterday, couldn’t take it anymore. It remembered the three days its Master lay down motionless, and now, the Master had also restricted their mind connection for some reason. The little bird could still feel its Master’s soul and life force, but it could no longer send or receive any thought.
Is Master happy? Is Master sad? It was unsettling for the bird to lose that information.
The little bird struggled inside the demon’s hold, and almost managed to escape before Caba helped Dhuarta hold the bird back--they’d be dead if the bird lost its innocence because of their negligence.
"Wait, wait, wait--you can’t go yet, Sir Jade!" the two vassals tried to hold the little bird without hurting it, which proved to be a hard thing to do when the elemental bird started to use mana.
[Jade want Master!!]
"Jade wants to see Valen," the Salamander interpreted from the breakfast table.
"I can see that well enough," Lesta chuckled, and proceeded to call for the little bird. If Jade would listen to someone other than the human, then it would be its candy provider Lesta. "Jade, come here."
At Lesta’s voice, the bird ceased its struggle and flew slowly toward the demon, landing on Lesta’s palm with a sad-sounding chirp.
"Do you want to see your Master?"
[Ung...] It was a pitiful sound akin to an abandoned child.
"Why?" Lesta asked patiently.
[Because Jade miss Master...]
"Jade misses Valen," again, Ignis interpreted for them.
Lesta smiled; a gentle one, unlike his usual smile. He patted the sad little bird on his palm while speaking softly. "His Lordship also the same," he said. "He misses your Master, because he’d been so busy the past week."
The little bird slowly looked up, the beady eyes blinked at the demon’s explanation.
"Isn’t that why you had been able to spend a lot of time playing with your Master every day?"
[Oh...]
The slumped wings slowly gain some strength, and the green eyes no longer look as depressed as before. With a wider smile, Lesta continued. "So now, give a chance to His Lordship, yes? You can play with us instead, alright?"
The beady eyes blinked repeatedly for a bit, and the little gecko hopped into Lesta’s arm, patting the green head. After looking back and forth between Ignis and Lesta, also the vassals who were nodding in affirmation with wide smiles, the little bird finally nodded.
[Okay!]
Finally, the chirping sound was back to its usual high tone instead of the sad whimpering from before.
"Good," Lesta patted the little bird again, before putting the plump colorful ball of feathers on the table. "Young Master will be so proud of you for being so mature."
The bird turned around with a gasp. [Jade mature?]
Leata smirked and nodded. "Yes, like a proper adult."
[!!]
As if there was an exclamation mark on its head, the bird jumped around and, together with the Salamander, huddled and giggled in the corner--almost as if it was already forgotten about its Master’s absence.
Dhuarta let out a long sigh and patted her twin’s shoulder. "You’re a certified babysitter now."
"Bird-sitter," Opti corrected.
* * *
On the third day, the Master emerged. "Jade!!"
[Master!]
A high pitch, mirthful chirping filled the cabin lounge with the emergence of the lovely figure, looking as beautiful as always, and even more energetic than usual. The green eyes shone brightly like a pair of emeralds, and he welcomed the little bird’s tackle with open arms and cheerful laughter.
"Have you been good? Do you miss me?"
[Yes!]
The master and familiar hugged each other as if they hadn’t met for three weeks instead of three days. The elemental bird was on the verge of sulking, but seeing the cheerful Master and the happiness seeping into its soul, the bird forgot all of its loneliness.
The Salamander, who quietly jumped on the human-druid’s shoulder, remarked in a dry tone. "I’m not."
"Yes, yes, I miss you too, Ignis,"
While the Salamander mumbled about how that’s not what it said at all, the little bird was busy bragging. [Jade is good. Jade wait patient like adult!]
"Patiently," the Master corrected.
[Jade wait patiently like proper adult!]
"Yes, yes, good boy!"
With a joyful laugh, the Master had a lovely reunion with his little companions while the vassals watched intriguingly.
"He looks so...energetic," Caba commented with wonder.
"I have to admit this is unexpected," Dhuarta said while glancing at another person who also graced them with his presence at long last.
"That it is His Lordship that would come up looking like he just came back from a battlefield?" Opti chuckled, blatantly smirking at his Lord. "Yeah, that’s unexpected."
The vassals turned to look at the Lord who was leaning on the couch with an arm covering his eyes, listless and clearly exhausted.
"Druids," the Nightmare spoke, the low energy level made his voice sound like a growl. "Have natural rejuvenation,"
When his lovely bride asked for a whole night of sexual activity, Natha was more than excited to comply. Who wouldn’t, when their lover saying it with a blushing face and fluttering lashes out of embarrassment? A lover that until last week was still a total virgin.
They did it until the sun rises, and did it again in the bath chamber. Which was fine and fun. But after a short rest, that lovely, just-graduated virgin lover seduced him again, shyly asking for another round. And another. And another.
Like a new adventurer, his innocent lover was eager to explore everything. Everything. It was the curiosity that Natha remembered from the man’s previous life, from night after night of questions. It was just that the questions now changed into something more physical and sensual.
In front of this eager lover, his pride did not allow him to stop, and when they woke up on the third morning, he felt like he had used up all of the energy he saved for winter. On the other hand, Valen looked extremely refreshed, the druid gene worked wonders in restoring his energy. It was also why the seemingly fragile man could last for many many many rounds with peak excitement.
Unknowingly, Natha had woken up this lovely monster of coexisting innocence and promiscuity.
"Pfft--" Lesta stifled his laugh unsuccessfully. "He sucked you dry, huh?"
With a sharp glare, Natha sneered at his right-hand man. "Yeah? Like it won’t be the same with you once you get back?"
Lesta paused, blinking hard as he was suddenly filled with forgotten dread.
"Mm, a month-long thirst," Dhuarta leaned back on her chair and licked her lips. "Delicious,"
Lesta slapped his twin hard, although his complexion was getting paler.
"Hey!"
"Ugh," the usually calm demon started to sweat and looked pleadingly to his Lord--the Lord he just teased. "Can’t you like...sending me on a mission somewhere, my Lord?"
"And prolonging the thirst? You really want to be sucked dry?" Natha smirked, feeling better now that he had someone else to tease.
With a mischievous giggle, Dhuarta and Opti patted the groaning Lesta in fake consolation.

chapters.title: Chapter 207: Teaching your kids to share is important
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Teaching your kids to share is important
"Oh!"
Just as they said, the southern volcano region was not at all like Ignie’s home. Even though it was almost winter, I could still see that it was lush and rich. There was a leftover scene of the autumn harvest, which was very nice to look at.
"Is it really enough here?" Natha asked behind me.
"Yes, it’s okay," I nodded while holding onto the railing. "I can do it from this distance now."
Even though my blockade hadn’t been completely erased, the healing of my soul made me stronger, and more sensitive than before. I didn’t have to go to the peak or down the core of the mountain to feel the fire elemental mana, and if I could feel it, I could absorb it.
Natha gave a signal to the Captain with one hand, and held me by my chest with another. At his order, the barrier system covering the deck was retreating, and we were blasted with a cold wind. I stumbled back a little, crashing into Natha’s chest. But otherwise, it wasn’t too bad.
But let’s say I understand the importance of the barrier over the ship very much now.
So, without wasting any more time, I started to process the fire elemental. Thankfully, absorbing the elemental mana did not require physical manifestation to occur, so I wouldn’t have to combust in Natha’s embrace. Ignis also helped me fasten the process, guiding the elemental mana to be absorbed faster.
Once the absorption was complete, the barrier could be returned. The purification process itself did not require me to keep getting connected to the source, which was fortunate, because it could take a long time depending on the amount. Opening the barrier for too long wouldn’t be very comfortable, wasn’t it?
But just like how I became more sensitive, purifying the mana also became easier. It took me just an hour, more or less, to refine the fire elemental of a whole volcano into a ball of condensed light-orange energy the size of a balloon.
"No," was the first thing I said when I opened my eyes, because I could feel Jade was going to jump inside the energy ball as usual. "No, this is not for you, Jade."
[Eeeeh?] the bird paused mid-air and flopped down in disappointment. Well, I couldn’t blame Jade because I had been prioritizing its growth before. But it was time for my child to know they should share things with others.
"You know it’s not easy to come upon fire elemental mana, right?" I explained slowly to the little bird. "You know Ignis can only eat the fire one, right? Whereas you can eat everything."
[Yeah...]
"So you have to let Ignis have this one, okay?"
[...Okay]
But even though Jade said okay, it still sounded sad and disappointed. Hmm...Jade usually listened to me well, but this reminded me of the time the bird acted jealous of my attention toward the bullet.
Could it be that Jade was sulky because I spent two days and three nights with Natha inside the bedroom?
Swallowing my laugh, I stroke the little bird gently. "Let Ignis have this one, because you’ll get everything else after this, okay? Sharing is a good thing, Jade, and my Jade is a good child, right? A good bird? Mm?"
[Jade...Jade a good bird...] the bird nodded and I kissed the green head with a laugh, nuzzling the plump cheek.
Did this bird gain weight?
Just then, the Salamander climbed into my hand too, and patted the little bird. "I’ll give you some, so don’t be sad."
"Oh, my--look, Jade, Ignis will give you some, what do you say?"
[Really?]
"Mm, just a little bit, because I’m hungry,"
The bird visibly perked up then, but looked at me first for confirmation.
"What do you say to Ignis?"
Jade turned toward the little gecko and chirped energetically. [Thank you Ignis!]
"Mm,"
[Jade will give Ignis candy and jelly too!]
"Ooh, what a nice boy," I ruffled the green head and Jade chirped loudly in response. Ignis just scoffed, but didn’t say anything about not liking sweet anymore this time.
I proceeded to divide the energy ball into two, and gave Jade a ping-pong size ball. This time, it was Ignis who stayed inside the other ball. The Salamander didn’t roll around like Jade, but it looked happy nonetheless. It was fun looking at them eating in happiness, and I wondered if this was what parents would feel watching their kids eating.
I wondered if my parents ever felt like that about me...
"You really don’t feel tired, Young Master?" Arta crouched down and joined me to watch my two little companions gobbling the energy ball.
"No?" I tilted my head, looking at Arta whose gaze seemed to be a mix of worry and fascination. I felt like everyone had been looking at me like this since I came out this morning, even Panne. "Should I?"
She didn’t reply immediately, just looking at me in silence and intrigued gaze. It was as if she was trying to see if I was telling the truth. "Hmm...you were really having fun, huh, those three nights," she whispered suddenly.
"Uhh..." I flinched at her remark, and then looked around slightly. Finding Natha was talking to the Captain and not there to hear my response, I let out a quiet giggle. Arta raised her brow and I leaned slightly to whisper in her ear. "Umm...I try to do what the courtesans told me."
She gasped and pulled away to look at me with widened eyes. "All of them?"
"Well...I’m curious," I shrugged.
Arta blinked at my response and proceeded to laugh, slapping my arm playfully while whispering back. "Seesh...you should save some for your honeymoon you know,"
"H-honeymoon..." I clasped my hands over my mouth in embarrassment. That sweet phrase somehow held something very sensual about it and I couldn’t help being flustered, even after spending days and nights in bed with him.
Hmm...it did make me wonder if I should have saved some of my curiosity for that allegedly important day. "Well...there’s something that I haven’t tried..." I told her after a while.
"Wow, wow, wow," suddenly, I heard Opti’s voice behind us. "What a scandalous conversation we have here."
It almost made me jump in surprise, but I had no leeway to get flustered when Lesta also chimed in. "So we can expect the honeymoon to be wild too, huh?"
"It...it wasn’t
that
wild," I muttered while averting the vassals’ inquisitive gaze.
"Yeah, right," Opti smirked in doubt, but even I could hear the bullshit in my defense.
Well, to be fair, nothing was broken, I have to tell you. We just...made a little mess, dirtying the sheet, and the carpet, and the bathroom floor, and...well, it was just a mess, okay? We did not damage the furniture or anything.
So calling it wild was rather too much, wasn’t it?
"But we’ve been talking about honeymoon without even knowing when the wedding would be," Arta said with a long sigh, prompting a harsh reaction from the other two.
"Hey!"
Arta flinched, and, as if realizing something, looked at me with an awkward expression. "Oh, I mean..."
I looked at them in confusion, because they seemed to feel guilty or something. "What?"
Arta looked at Lesta and Opti, and for a while, they just looked at each other in silence. But eventually, Arta opened her mouth.
"Umm...Young Master," she shifted closer and asked in a quiet voice. "Does...does His Lordship ever talk to you about a wedding? Marriage?"
"Hmm...no?" I tilted my head, trying to remember if we ever talked about it. But we had been busy talking about other things, and if it was something that important, I should have remembered it, right?
I caught the vassals’ gaze, and it seemed like they were confused about my reaction. Was it because there was no wedding talk, or was it because I didn’t seem to care too much?
"Oh, but..." I looked down, and stared at my hand--the mark, as well as the ring in my fingers. "He did give me an ’engagement’ ring, and...the contract said the stuff about being a bride came after I fully healed," I told them. "I’m not actually obliged to become one before then, but...you know...I fell for him, so..."
"Then it doesn’t matter isn’t it, whether you’re fully healed or not," Arta commented with a slight frown.
Oh? It seemed like they actually wanted the wedding to happen?
"Hmm...knowing him, he probably wants things to be perfect," I offered an explanation. "Because, you know, there’s still dangers and everything,"
"Make sense," Lesta nodded while poking Jade’s bulging cheek. "The banquet last time could be a test."
"To see if it’s safe to bring Young Master to a public setting?"
"Yes, and to see if people accept him,"
Opti decided to lie down across the desk while watching my two companions eating. "I don’t think His Lordship cares about acceptance, though?"
"He’s not," Lesta smirked, and added while looking at me. "But he cares about making it a happy event for his bride, no?"
"Ah, right,"
I listened to their discussion about this ’wedding’ with a tickling heart, but in the end, I didn’t feel burdened by it after all. "I don’t really care, we’re already together anyway," I told them.
"Well, well, well--look at this confidence," Arta pinched my arms and laughed, and we continued watching Ignis and Jade with a light heart.
"By the way, Young Master," Lesta asked after a while. "How’s the progress with your homework?"
...crap!

chapters.title: Chapter 208: I too, want to pretend that I am mighty and omniscient
chapters.content:
Chapter 208: I too, want to pretend that I am mighty and omniscient
I had wondered once; why people always pushed doing their homework for the last day. Why didn’t they do it before, little by little so they didn’t have to face agonizing piles of homework? Was it so hard to do?
Hah! The joke was on me!
Because that was exactly what I was doing on the last day of our journey home; working through Eruha’s homework. I had to beg Lesta and Natha to help me with it, filling me in on the things I forgot during the visit.
Making several essays analyzing the economic and cultural situation of the region wasn’t something easy to do when we were in a hurry, turned out. I also totally forgot that I had to record the three topmost commodities in each town and city we visited. Mapping was easier because I liked to see the landscape from the deck every time we flew.
But damn--I would never think bad about those students delaying their work anymore.
At first, Jade was sulking because I couldn’t play, but seeing that I was busy doing my homework instead of spending time with Natha put the bird in a better mood. Jade even helped me bring some papers and candies to refill my sugar intake, while Ignis kept me warm even while I was rolling on the floor while doing my essays.
And with everyone’s help, I could finish my homework in time! Yaay!
Although...why was it that I felt Lesta was rather disappointed in my narrow escape?
Was it had something to do with how he stayed as far as possible from Eruha when we finally landed safely on the Castle? Eruha and Malta were there to welcome us, and I saw Lesta inch further and further away to the back of the group. But I also saw the vampire’s sharp gaze always managed to find the demon.
How suspicious...
Eruha didn’t say anything though, just kept conversing with me and Natha. His eyes though--his eyes never left the nervous Lesta.
Hmm...lovers’ business?
"Teacher Eru, I finished the homework!" I saluted the vampire and Panne brought forth my frantic day’s work.
"How excellent, Young Master. Seems like I don’t have to put you in an extra lesson anymore," Eruha smiled approvingly, and I hoped he didn’t realize that I did everything in a day and night. "You can enjoy your winter vacation with ease now, for I won’t hold the lesson for a while until I finish grading your homework."
"Yay, Jade! Playtime!"
[Playtime!]
I high-fived the little bird with a cheerful laugh that was the opposite of Lesta’s grumble. I bet my free playtime meant he got a playtime too--with a vampire!
After a short welcome back and so on, Natha and I went back to our quarters with my little companions, and I saw Lesta slip out of the group to his own quarter. But then, I also saw Eruha smile so deeply that I felt a shiver down my spine.
Err...good luck, Lesta, for whatever it should be.
I was planning to introduce our place to Ignis first, but Panne, who already headed back to manage my stuff while we were chatting with the others, came to tell us some news.
It seemed like Heraz was here.
* * *
Actually, Heraz had been here since a few days ago, but well, in his own words;
"I can go anywhere, Young Master, but the air is a bit..."
Well, yeah, I understood. Even if he could fly, getting past that barrier would be tricky. So Heraz went away again to wait until the airship
arrived. I laughed and lamented at the fact that we didn’t have a phone at a time like this, and Natha whispered that we were going to make it someday, before kissing my cheek and disappearing to the dressing room.
Heraz was looking at us unblinking, his expressionless face morphed into surprised for a second before going back to stare at the floor again. Just about everyone had expressed their astonishment at Natha’s slight change--in their eyes, apparently, it wasn’t slight--so I had gotten used to it.
"What news do you bring for me?" I asked him then, after Panne retreated from the room, and I told Jade to show Ignis their ’room’.
"I had compiled the information about Midas that you asked, Young Master," he fetched a roll of parchment from his storage ring and delivered it to me with extra politeness--just the way he always acted when Natha was around.
"Oh, thank you," I took the thin parchment and cast it aside for now because there was something else I needed to know.
"What about the Hero?"
I could see from the corner of my eyes that Natha was peeking from the dressing room with narrowed eyes. What--was he jealous again?
"With the help of Midas, they succeeded in the rebellion effort, but much was destroyed in the process, so they were trying to see a way to fix it," Heraz reported, before adding. "Not everything can be solved with money, after all."
"I can attest to that," Natha said while emerging from the dressing room, wearing something more casual and joining me on the couch.
Well, we did just go through something that couldn’t be fixed with money. Even after gaining Amrita, my soul couldn’t be healed. No amount of money could buy a deity’s favor, or else Natha would already conquering the whole world.
War, external or internal, always left destruction in its wake. Even after everything was over, the damage could not be undone. Buildings could be built, crops could be replanted. But lost lives couldn’t be brought back with money, and time couldn’t be bought. Crops couldn’t be planted on top of destroyed land which life force had been sucked out and dried.
And this was why druids shouldn’t be erased from the world. So stupid.
Wait...
"Are they...looking for a magician right now?"
Heraz raised his face and blinked his widened eyes. "H-how...do you know, Young Master?"
Hmm...I wanted to pretend that I was very smart and awesome, but my mind was occupied by this matter for now. I was suddenly reminded of why the hero group was looking for a magician in the prompt I heard.
The land. The land that was getting corrupted by the civil war, the leyline that was getting dried up because people sucked out the mana for their fight. This world wasn’t as simple as the Earth in which magic was very prevalent in people’s livelihood and environment. A land without mana could not support anything to live above it, just like the desertification that happened around the northern volcano.
"Sweetheart?" Natha caressed my hair, and I snapped out of my deep thought.
"Ah, sorry," I looked at the surprised Heraz again, who had just broken one of his codes and looked at me rather than the floor. "The civil war must have damaged the land, and now they tried to look for a solution to get it to function again...right?"
"Y-yes," the pale demon finally lowered his face again.
"They don’t have access to the realm of nature, thanks to the Empire destroying the Druid Kingdom," I huffed in annoyance, sprinkling a little sneer there. "So rather than looking for a druid, they’d be looking for a magician specialized in elemental magic."
Heraz flinched slightly on the floor, before replying in a dazed voice. "Precisely, Young Master."
"Alright," I tapped on my lips, trying to remember the timeline of the novel. But it was rather hard to discern it from verbal prompts. "Is there anything else?"
"They are still looking for the magician, and we’ll keep on following them,"
"Mm..." I moved my head left and right to get my brain to work. Where was it...where was this magician in seclusion lived..."The Empire," I opened the eyes I didn’t realize were closing, and looked at Heraz. "The magician will be in the Empire, in one of the uninhabited islands in the middle of the biggest lake there--ah, well, I guess it’s no longer uninhabited in that case..."
Again, Heraz looked up and blinked. "You mean...Lake Velnas?"
"I don’t know geography well, Heraz..." I pursed my lips, and Natha laughed while patting my head.
"Yes, the biggest lake with many islands in the middle of it would be Lake Velnas," Natha said. "The lake used to be the borderline between the Empire and the Druid Kingdom."
"Ugh--"
My lips twisted even more. How weird, now everything about the fall of the kingdom felt truly personal to me. It was weird because, without the fall of the kingdom, I wouldn’t even be born--theoretically. But it still pissed me off nonetheless.
Was getting my soul whole and meeting Mother made me feel closer to the druid as my kin? I even naturally called the Goddess by ’Mother’ now.
Somehow I had the urge to check on my ears in the mirror--in case it got longer just like the druid.
"A-anyway, just follow them when they start to go in that direction," I told Heraz. "And..." I hesitated a little bit, before turning to look at Natha. "I think...they might come looking for you too,"
Natha raised his brow. "They? As in the Hero and his companions?"
I nodded silently. I forgot that I hadn’t mentioned this to him at all despite telling him about the novel; about the prompt that the author girl had mentioned to me before her death.
"Why?"
"Because they will need the Amrita," I told him carefully.
"
Your
Amrita?" he tilted his head, and I could see the gear in his mind turning. "Is the magician in need of
your
Amrita?"
I had no idea how he could keep making me blush in the middle of a serious conversation like this, but he easily did, simply by saying the Amrita was mine. He essentially said that he procured this one-of-a-kind miracle drug solely for my sake, and my stomach felt as if Jade was jumping inside.
"Most likely, yeah..." I replied quietly, to hide how flustered I was. So I shifted my gaze to Heraz again, to avoid looking at Natha’s face. "Well, so that’s it, just keep watching them a while longer."
Heraz, however, didn’t move or say ’by your command’ as usual. The pale, iridescent eyes still looked at me, wide and unblinking that I started to worry.
"Umm...Heraz?"
"Young Master..." he said in a dazed tone. "Are you perhaps...a seer?"
I had to press my lips hard as Natha stifled his laugh by burying his face on my shoulder.

chapters.title: Chapter 209: My evil, cunning, kidnapper Demon Lord
chapters.content:
Chapter 209: My evil, cunning, kidnapper Demon Lord
"Is this why you asked Heraz to follow the Hero?" Natha asked after Heraz left the room to get on with his new mission.
"Yeah, why else would I care about him?" I shrugged. "I need to track when they would arrive in the Lair and contact you."
And avoid a potential bloodbath--but I didn’t tell him that.
"Huh..."
Natha made a face as if he was in a daze, like he was thinking of his past attitude and probably regretting it a bit. I shifted closer to poke his cheek and grinned. "Hehe...do you finally realize your jealousy is ridiculous?"
He raised his brow at my words and twisted his lips for a bit. Was he feeling embarrassed? I did not really know how he looked when he was embarrassed because he had been preventing me from looking at it.
"No," he replied dryly, making his face flat.
Ah...it just made me want to tease him more. I had to press my lips to hold back from laughing. I mean...I didn’t know if I would have a chance to tease him anymore in the future.
"Huh...just admit it," I poked his cheek again, and was about to pinch it just like how he usually did to me.
But he caught my arms before I could do that, and pulled me into his lap, biting my cheek as revenge and tickling my waist until I was squirming and laughing and forgot about teasing him.
"No," he hissed and nipped at my jaw playfully. "For all I know, he could still fall for you when you two meet."
"Huh? Where is that coming from?" I pulled my face away from his attacking lips and looked at him dumbfoundedly.
"I just know," the silver eyes narrowed, and he used his stubborn voice--the one I remembered from the time we had the late-night debate in the hospital. "I know his type."
Why did this demon suddenly become unreasonable?
"How?"
"I just know,"
I had to bite my lips because...why did he turn cute so suddenly like this? I clasped his cheeks and nuzzled him just the way I usually did to Jade. He just put his arms around my waist and let me do that, all the while still putting on that flat and cool face.
"How suspicious," I tilted my head and circled my arms around his neck, rubbing the back of his head. "Mmh, anyway, I don’t have any interest in the Hero other than the fact he might end up here," I decided to stop teasing him about it. It was plenty cute already, and it made my heart tingle how he would have this silly jealousy over someone I never even knew. "I don’t even think about him unless Heraz comes with the news."
I pinched and stroked his cheek lightly, but Natha just hummed flatly. "Ah, why?" I pursed my lips and hit his shoulder lightly in annoyance.
It was now Natha who looked at me with teasing eyes. "Nothing, I just want to act sulky so my lover would pamper me," he smirked pulling my waist closer to his pelvis.
"What a sly man," I hissed against his lips, so close now as our faces were just inches from each other.
His brow arched and one side of his mouth curled up charmingly. "I’m a Demon Lord,"
"Oh, right," I gasped dramatically. "You’re supposed to be evil and cunning!"
"Heh," Natha chuckled and slipped his hands beneath my clothes, rubbing my bare waist as I squirmed in his lap. "You seem so eager for someone being kidnapped by a Demon Lord,"
My skin shuddered at his cold touch, and I bit my lips before whispering with a laugh. "It’s probably Stockholm syndrome,"
He laughed too, lips vibrating against my ears. The lips that proceeded to nip on my earlobe and kissed my neck slowly. As I tilted my head to give him better access, my eyes caught the parchment that Heraz had given me earlier.
"Oh, the stuff about Midas!" I gasped, and twisted out of his hold to take the neglected report.
Natha looked at me dumbfoundedly, hands still on my waist, and eyes still with a trace of lust. "I really can’t read you out..." he muttered with a tinge of disappointment.
"No, no, listen--" I shifted to turn around and, while still on his lap, now had my back against his chest. "There’s something I’ve been wondering,"
Natha sighed and took his hands out of my clothes. "What?"
"I wonder if that author girl was getting sent here too," I looked up to find his arched brow. "I mean, considering that she received the ’revelation’ or whatever about this world..."
"Hmm, make sense," he finally stopped looking disappointed in failing to ravish me in the middle of the day--even though he was the one who told me to stop the other day, hmph. Natha tilted his head while absentmindedly twirling my hair in his finger. "So you think she is someone behind this Midas?"
"Right--Natha, is Midas a phrase or name that originally came from here?" I asked the thing I had been curious about, but couldn’t ask anyone for obvious reasons. Well, I supposed I could ask Izzi, but he didn’t know much about this world too due to his isolatorian lifestyle.
Hmm...perhaps I should tell him about my situation too.
"No, I don’t think so," Natha answered me after thinking about it for a while. "At least, not from the demon realm."
"Yeah," I nodded. I could attest that Valmeier had never heard about that phrase before too, but I wouldn’t count on him to know much about general knowledge, honestly. Still...
"So I thought whoever named the guild Midas might be coming from Earth, just like Izzi," I told him while putting on mana into the cord tying the parchment.
"I see,"
"Oh, you know about Izzi too, don’t you?" I shifted and turned to see him. Ah, there was still so much we needed to talk about now that we know about each other’s past.
"Of course," Natha leaned back on the couch, answering without hesitation. "How else would I get interested in that failed product? Finding him and the other inventors was my way of looking for you too,"
Ah...that made sense. The reason why he could see that the invention wasn’t trash and was willing to invest a lot was because he knew those inventions, should they work, would bring massive change and immense profit for him. On the other hand, he must have been excited to see the things he saw on Earth at that time--a little proof that indeed, it wasn’t just his delusion, that someone from that world could end up here too.
"And although they are not you, finding them gave me hope that you’d come someday if I wait long enough," he confirmed my conjecture, stroking my hair softly while saying it.
Gosh--you shouldn’t make me blush before we even had dinner, my Lord!
"You are so romantic, you know," I whispered sheepishly.
"Oh, good," he tilted his head and smirked. "That should warrant a kiss, don’t you think?"
I giggled and kissed his lips, just a soft and short one. Before he could catch my lips, however, I pulled away and turned around again, leaning against his chest. "Okay, back to this Midas."
Natha groaned slightly behind me and I hid my smile behind the parchment. The seal on the cord now had come undone and I spread it out to read it. Natha put his head on my shoulder and read the report together with me.
"Mm, mm," I nodded after reading it for a while. "So they began to grow rapidly in the past few years by making revolutionary products, huh?" I glanced at the handsome face on my shoulder. "Sounds familiar,"
"You’re talking about me?" Natha tilted my head in fake innocence, and I elbowed him lightly until he laughed.
"But seeing that they focused on products rather than capital, I think it’s a textbook case of someone getting reincarnated or transmigrated with limited knowledge of the other world, and making innovation on things pertaining to daily needs that they knew best--unlike the ambitious inventors," I continued. This Midas was especially known for making new food and introducing ways to preserve food better and longer. They were big because of this, since it was a commodity that people used daily. "I don’t think they have a financial adventure like you."
"Might also be young," Natha commented.
"Yeah,"
"Like that author friend of yours?" he stroked my cheek, finding exactly what I wanted from this report. "It says the guildmaster had a young daughter,"
"Yeah..." I kept my eyes on the mention of the guildmaster’s daughter, who was said to be involved actively in the running of the guild. The daughter was young, two years below me.
Just like the author girl.
Of course, I knew this reincarnation or transmigration stuff had no business with age. She could be here from a long long time ago, or she could be reincarnated just a few years back, and just a baby right now.
But just as Natha clung to a bit of hope of my existence from the trace of another world’s dwellers, I too, wanted to believe that it wasn’t just a coincidence.
"Do you want to meet her?" Natha asked softly, perhaps because he saw my solemn expression.
"Natha," I put the parchment down and sighed, before looking up at his beautiful silver eyes. "I wouldn’t be able to find you if it wasn’t for her."

chapters.title: Chapter 210: Exploring things is fun, but what about exploring the secret of the universe?
chapters.content:
Chapter 210: Exploring things is fun, but what about exploring the secret of the universe?
"What are you doing there?"
I looked up as the dome of blanket covering my head was lifted, and caught the amused gaze of silver eyes, hooded by sleepiness and arousal--which I felt clearly within my palm.
Giggling slightly, I pressed my lips onto the cold, throbbing flesh in front of my face, and licked it. The hand that got rid of the blanket was now on my head, scraping my scalp with the sound of harsh breath from above.
"So naughty this early in the morning?" Natha arched his brow, and I shrugged.
"It was hard, like..."
"Like...?"
I stroked the length with my hands and tilted my head. "Like it asked me to do something?"
"And this is your conclusion?"
Trailing the pulsing vein to the smooth, round head, I looked up and asked against the twitching slit. "Should I stop?"
"Are you kidding me?" the cold hand on my hair tightened slightly, before sliding into my nape and rubbing there gently. "Go on," Natha parted his lips, half smiling and letting out a quiet growl from deep within his chest.
So I continued, shifting my body to a more comfortable position between his legs and started to put the hard length in my mouth. This was only my third time doing it, so I wasn’t really proficient yet. But I had to say I found myself to be lacking in gag reflex, so it had been rather a fun experience rather than a painful one--despite Natha’s size.
It was mainly fun because Natha looked the most disorderly while I did it. His scrunched face, frowning brows, and parted lips let out a low, raspy breath. Oftentimes, repeatedly, he would grab my hair, seemingly wanting to slam my face into his crotch. But he never did it; he would hold his grip for a few seconds, before letting go with gritted teeth and cheeks flushed deeper in color. Glancing at the way he looked as he suppressed his desire got me tingling all over.
And the most fun of it all was tasting the cold fluid that came out with a harsh growl and tight grip on the back of my head. I would suck it off and swallow everything, licking the leftover drop until he pulled me up to kiss my cheek and the corner of my glazed eyes.
"To think you’re a virgin just a few weeks ago," he chuckled while wiping the corner of my mouth after fixing his pants back.
"Technically," I raised my finger to correct him. "I’m still a virgin."
He looked at me dumbfoundedly for a few seconds before bursting out laughing, kissing my neck and shoulder further, grazing my skin with his pattern and stubble until I squirmed from the ticklish sensation.
"You like that?" he asked with a smirk as I licked my lips and savored the leftover taste.
"Mm," I nodded and tried to review the taste. "It’s like an ice cream, no--" It was cold, just like the rest of him, and refreshing, with a hint of sweetness and a slight sourness at the tip of my tongue. "Yogurt?" I corrected.
He pressed his lips and leaned his head against my shoulder, laughing until his back was shaking. "What? It’s true!"
Obviously, I didn’t know what other men’s cum tasted like, but I imagined it wouldn’t taste like this. The courtesans told me that cum and slick tasted different depending on the quality of the mana inside someone. So instead of the food that we ate or our general lifestyle, the taste was influenced by the characteristics of our mana, and the purity of it.
Meaning, the more mana we had, and the purer it was, the tastier it would be.
See why I said it was fun?
"Mm, as long as you like it," Natha kissed me.
"What about mine?" I tilted my head, and Natha made a pondering face.
"Hmm...like a custard? Soft and sweet like you," his eyes curled and gazed downward, and even though it was me who asked the question, I got flustered by the answer. "Would you like a turn?"
"...no," I laid my head down on his chest and sighed. "I just want to cuddle,"
He chuckled and pulled up the blanket to cover me--us--again, just in time as the door clicked open and a servant came with our morning tray. I flinched and in dread, realized that a servant could come in the middle of me sucking Natha earlier.
Note to self: make sure to lock the door before doing naughty naughty.
The servants paused for a bit when they realized we had woken up already, and proceeded to bow deeply. They swiftly put the tray on the table and retreated without lifting their gaze off the floor. I would never know whether they did that because of the culture of not staring at the Lord’s eyes--and his partner’s too, apparently--or because they were embarrassed by catching us in an intimate situation.
I was embarrassed getting caught in this intimate situation, even though we were fully clothed--well, Natha’s night robe was a little loose because I was spending a long time staring at his pecs and abs before going down on him, but he still technically clothed.
"You’re still embarrassed after all this time?" Natha laughed softly while stroking my hair with one hand and rubbing my reddened ears with another.
"It’s because I’m a person with decency," I pursed my lips.
"Who woke up his lover with a blowjob?" he raised his brow. I grinned sheepishly and he pinched my cheek. "Why did you wake up so early anyway?"
I paused then, suddenly remembered why I couldn’t sleep last night and ended up waking up way before dawn. Gasping, I got up and grabbed his shoulder. "The Egg!"
* * *
No, I didn’t dream of anything last night.
But before falling asleep, I had a nagging feeling in the back of my mind that I was forgetting something. And I only recalled what it was when I woke up in the middle of the night.
The Egg! The Seed!
Natha told me he would tell me about it more when we got back, in front of the Egg itself.
But then, I guess the frantic effort of finishing my homework, as well as Heraz’s arrival with the news pushed it away from my mind.
I tried to sleep again after that, telling myself to think about it tomorrow instead because I didn’t want to wake up Natha in the dead of the night just for that. But I couldn’t.
So, to distract myself, I was...well, let’s say I filled my mind with something even more distracting than the Egg while watching my Demon Lord’s sleeping face. Face and everything else.
And now, I watched Natha getting up from the bed and approaching the armchair beneath the window. He took something from a hidden compartment below the chair and put it on my hand.
"What is this?" I looked at the small notebook in my hand, which was protected by some kind of seal.
Natha reached out his hand and tapped on the brand in the back of my hand. "Try it,"
Intrigued, I put my palm atop the notebook and channel a mana inside. The book made a soft clicking noise and the seal was undone.
"It’s the second volume," Natha said to me in a playful tone.
I didn’t get it immediately at first, but when I looked at the notebook again, a memory of another book lying inside the drawer of a certain tower made me gasp. Swiftly, I opened the notebook, and a familiar handwriting greeted my eyes.
"The sequel!" I raised the journal and he laughed softly in response.
"That’s where I wrote my experience after being called to the Sanctuary," he explained as I flipped the page. "What His Majesty said to me, what I remember from that short time with you, what I did after that..."
Oh my God...this must be Natha’s biggest secret. It basically contained the Demon God’s decree and the reason behind his wealth. No wonder it was put under a complicated seal--if it wasn’t by his specific manaprints, it wouldn’t open. Well, and my manaprints too, now, apparently.
Wow...my heart was beating fast when I started to read the entry as we walked toward the treasure room. It started from the place that was getting cut off from the previous notebook--the darn cliffhanger. My eyes darted upon the words, but I had to pause and ask for his translation because he was jotting down the King’s words in archaic demonese.
And listening to his translation was...wild.
"P-procreation?"
"Mm,"
I swallowed and blinked hard. "Uhh...like...making child?"
"Yeah,"
Was this why...he’d been repeatedly asking me about having a child? I looked at him in a daze as he opened the door to the treasure room, and I was still in a daze when I followed him inside.
I recalled how he was looking confused when I said I never thought of having one because I knew I couldn’t get one. Was he wondering about this ’fate’ of him? Because...
How could two males procreate a life?
Would I magically grow a womb or something?
"It’s confusing, right?" Natha caressed my head softly. "It was for me too,"
When I stared at him without blinking, he continued with a wry smile. "I was wondering about whether or not my partner had been premeditated, and right after, my soul was propelled to the other world."
"To Earth?"
"Yeah," he stroked my chin and continued. "I woke up in a human body that has my face, in a vastly different environment. Everything was strange, and as his memories flooded into my mind, I felt so muddled and dizzy that I had to take a breather."
"...so you go to the rooftop..."
Natha gave me the warmest, sweetest smile. "Yes," he said, eyes never left mine as he continued. "I saw you, I caught you, and I fell in love."
"Just like that?"
"Just like that," he said. "It’s bizarre, isn’t it? I feel this strange reaction to your soul, so confusing and intriguing. It took me a few days to realize that it was you; that you must be the one I sent there to see."
"But...but what if it’s actually not--"
I bit my lips, suddenly feeling my nape grow cold. What if...what if the person he actually had to meet was someone else? What if...what if it was the author girl--

chapters.title: Chapter 211: There are truly a lot of roads leading to Rome; as long as we find the roads
chapters.content:
Chapter 211: There are truly a lot of roads leading to Rome; as long as we find the roads
What if it was the author girl--
"Oh, believe me, sweetheart," he grasped my cheek and stroked them, looking at my eyes firmly as if telling me to erase any unnecessary thought. "I thought about that countless times," he said. "But the conclusion I reached had always been the same; no matter whether it’s truly you or if it’s actually someone else, my heart still goes to you. Only you."
"But..." I bit my lips. "Wouldn’t you think of a girl when talking about...making a child?"
Instead of responding with words, Natha pulled away slightly and tilted his head, silently looking at me with a smile as if he was waiting for something.
For an answer.
Oh!
"That’s..." I turned my head toward the artifact chamber. "That’s what...the Egg is for?"
He pulled my hand gently and opened the door to the chamber where the Egg was snuggly awaiting in its preservation tube. "Honestly, while I was in the other world with you, I didn’t think about that at all."
"You mean, about procreation?"
"Mm," a nostalgic smile carved on his lips. "All I could think about was you. How happy I was when I talked with you. How fast my heart beat when our hands were almost touching. How I want to stay by your side as long as I could,"
The hand holding me was tightening slightly, and I slipped my fingers between his, holding tighter.
"It was only after I got back that I realized the peculiarity and the problem with this," he chuckled with a reminiscing air. "But I was already outside the Sanctuary, and could no longer converse with His Majesty. I couldn’t ask about you anymore, or how would I go about that ’fate’ he told me about."
At this point, I just listened to his story quietly. All of these things he told me were there, written in the book as he poured everything he could remember from his partial transmigration as much as he could before he forgot about it. It was apparent in the slightly messy, hasty handwriting when he was so neat and meticulous before.
I could read it in this notebook, but it wouldn’t feel the same compared to hearing him telling it right now. His face seemed like it morphed back to his younger self, to the time when he met me for the first time. The bright eyes, even with different colors, overlapped with the Nat I knew throughout those night visits. The smile had that bit of mischievousness that he sometimes displayed when he argued with Jade.
"I thought about it long and hard while finishing my training with Teacher, but in the end, my conclusion stayed the same," he turned his head to look at me, silver eyes glimmering softly. "I don’t care what is supposed to be. For me, it’s just you."
